The Experience

More than dining — it's an aesthetic

Our Story

Dining as a
visual art form

The Sketch-Y Cuisine was born from a singular idea: that the space you dine in should feel as extraordinary as the food on your plate. Every detail — from the baroque scrollwork on the ceilings to the hand-curated china on the shelves — has been designed to immerse you in an experience unlike any other in Ajmer.

✦

Baroque Interiors

Black & white ornate design

🕯

Ambient Lighting

Crystal chandeliers & sconces

🍽

Private Dining

Events, birthdays & celebrations

🌃

City Views

Panoramic windows, 5th floor

The Aesthetic

A space made
for moments

Whether you're here for an intimate dinner or a lavish celebration, The Sketch-Y Cuisine sets the scene. The herringbone tiled floors, arched alcove shelving with fine white china, and grand ornate ceilings create a backdrop so beautiful, you'll want to capture every moment.

Made for the
content creators

Every corner of The Sketch-Y Cuisine is a frame waiting to be captured. From the ornate arched shelving to the dramatic chandelier ceiling — this is Ajmer's most photogenic dining destination.
